name: Loops
line: Email campaigns, event workflows and API-triggered transactional messages.

free.text: Free for first 1,000 contacts and 4,000 emails per 30 days

cells.api: Yes, transactional API and SMTP relay

subs.math: 1,000 contacts and 4,000 campaign emails fit within the free limits.
20,000 campaign emails to 5,000 contacts. The paid plan is shown at $49 a month.
40,000 campaign emails to 10,000 contacts. The paid plan is shown at $99 a month.
200,000 campaign emails to 50,000 contacts. The paid plan is shown at $249 a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 app emails fit the combined 4,000-email limit for any 30-day period, if nothing else is sent.
10,000 app emails are over the free quota. The exact paid price for an account used only for app emails is not published.
50,000 app emails are over the free quota. The exact paid price for an account used only for app emails is not published.
100,000 app emails are over the free quota. The exact paid price for an account used only for app emails is not published.
